Handwritten Azure Resource Manager responses, in the shapes of the REST reference
(learn.microsoft.com/rest/api, read 2026-11-06): compute `virtual-machines/get`,
virtualnetwork `network-interfaces/get`, `public-ip-addresses/get`, `subnets/get`,
`network-security-groups/get` (with `defaultSecurityRules`, which the GET returns) and
`service-tags/list` (paged with `nextLink`). Ids, names and addresses are invented.
